answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 63915 Country: India Title: Last time of zohar namaz Question: My colleague and me offer Zuhr namaz with jamat at office. Sometime we get late to offer namaz at right time. I want to know what is the last time of Zuhr namaz? After what time we have to intend of qaza namaz of Zuhr? Can we offer qaza namaz with jamat? Answer ID: 63915 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 537/537/SD=07/1437) According to Hanafi Fiqh, the Zuhr time remains till mithl thani i.e. till the original shade reaches equal to two of its size. You may fix mithl thani by any reliable calendar easily. وآخر وقتها عند أبي حنيفة إذا صار ظل كل شيئ مثليه سوى فيء الزوال . (هداية : 1/81، ط: مكتبه بلال ، ديوبند) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
